events.title: Haiti: Harrowing needs must be met with long-term engagement
events.summary: Escalating gang violence across Haiti has pushed displacement to record levels, deepening an already severe humanitarian crisis and leaving nearly 1.5 million people without a stable place to live, according to new figures released Friday...

events.title: Lebanon crisis: Needs soar as UN launches new funding appeal
